scope: Seven original benchmark-only inputs omitted from upstream CTest by .no_test markers. Runs preserve the upstream run_bench.sh drivers and original Lean/C options and arguments. Their expected-output test drivers are not suitable oracles for these benchmark-only inputs. No complete JavaScript suite is claimed.
measurementAdjustment: Host denies perf counters (perf_event_paranoid=4; perf stat -e instructions -- true exits 255). A separately hashed adapter preserves execution, output and status and measures actual wall time, child CPU time and max RSS. Hardware instructions/cycles are omitted. Original source and drivers are unchanged.
outputComparison: Exact output, except the seven explicitly formatted cbv and kernel millisecond timings in cbv_system_f.lean. Timings remain in raw evidence and are replaced only in comparisonOutput. Lean diagnostics, values and line numbers remain unchanged.
countsMeaning: Benchmark execution successes, not original expected-output CTest passes. Supplementary registrations remain separate from the 3896-entry broad campaign.

initialHarnessDiagnostic.reason: The initial optional registration used run_test.sh. Native rbmap_checkpoint2 printed 200001 200000 but has no expected-output file, so that driver failed. Two other native inputs passed; then the diagnostic was paused and preserved. Fresh r2 suites use the proper original benchmark drivers.
